title: Opening of the Smithsonian interview at Schuller's Newton home
summary: Schwartz identifies himself, the place and the project, and greets Schuller.

blocks.x: Funding for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program NEA Jazz Master interview was provided by the National Endowment for the Arts.
Interviewer: Steve Schwartz with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 87 pp.

This is Steve Schwartz from WGBH radio in Boston. We’re at the home of Gunther Schuller on Dudley Road in Newton Centre, Massachusetts, to do an oral history for the Smithsonian Oral History Jazz Program, if that’s the right title. Close enough? Hello Gunther.
